mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index level above 250.0 indicates elevated inflation, prompting central bank tightening expectations that depress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 250.0.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%) combined with high consumer spending (RSAFS > 500,000) signals robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days when monetary policy is accommodative (FEDFUNDS < 3.0%).
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% AND RSAFS > 500000 AND FEDFUNDS < 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (characterized by low unemployment, strong housing starts, and high inflation), rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250.0) triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 250.0 AND UNRATE < 4.0% AND HOUST > 1300.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in total nonfarm employment below 147,000 thousand indicates a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending power and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS < 147000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250.0) and declines in industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) signal a stagflationary risk, causing immediate equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 250.0 AND INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), a decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 < 17000) signals recession risk, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0% AND GDPC1 < 17000.
